why_realistic: _final_map is the exact function where this already happened once: it re-scored the golden set without passing side or crowdedness, so every demand card was re-scored with supply's weight vector, inside the calibration path that exists to catch that. lifecycle_stage is the third per-item argument on the same call and is persisted on the same record; dropping it re-scores a closed-window opportunity as if its window were still open.
oracle:
"""The weight-regression gate re-scores a persisted golden set, and every item must be re-scored
with ITS OWN lifecycle stage.

A fading opportunity carries a 0.55 downweight in production. Re-scoring it as if its window were
still open makes the gate measure a ranking production never produces, so the drift it reports is
drift against a fiction. This is the same per-item argument that this same function already failed to
thread once, for side and crowdedness.

Asserts on the returned map and the returned ranking, never on source text.
"""
import pytest

import score
from lib import load_config

DIMS = ("track_fit", "timing", "feasibility", "competition", "executability")
BD = {d: 70.0 for d in DIMS}


def _item(iid, stage):
    return {"id": iid, "side": "supply", "lifecycle_stage": stage,
            "score_breakdown": dict(BD), "n_sources": 3, "age_h": 12.0,
            "track_weight": 1.0}


def test_final_map_uses_each_items_own_lifecycle_stage():
    cfg = load_config()
    got = score._final_map([_item("aaa-fading", "fading"),
                            _item("zzz-emerging", "emerging")], None, cfg)
    assert got["aaa-fading"] < got["zzz-emerging"], (
        "a fading item was re-scored the same as an emerging one: %s" % got)
    direct = score.score_opportunity(dict(BD), 3, 12.0, None, 1.0, cfg, "fading",
                                     side="supply", crowdedness=None)["final_score"]
    assert got["aaa-fading"] == pytest.approx(direct), (
        "re-scoring disagrees with a direct score of the same fading item")


def test_rerank_puts_the_open_window_first():
    """The ids are chosen so the deterministic tie-break would put the FADING item first if the
    stage were dropped, which is the ranking the regression gate would then be measuring."""
    cfg = load_config()
    order = score.rerank([_item("aaa-fading", "fading"),
                          _item("zzz-emerging", "emerging")], None, cfg)
    assert order == ["zzz-emerging", "aaa-fading"], order


def test_a_record_with_no_stage_is_still_neutral():
    """Over-rejection guard: an older persisted record carries no stage and must not be penalized."""
    cfg = load_config()
    it = _item("no-stage", "emerging")
    it.pop("lifecycle_stage")
    got = score._final_map([it, _item("emerging", "emerging")], None, cfg)
    assert got["no-stage"] == pytest.approx(got["emerging"])
